title: AccountSnapshot
description: Account snapshot (EXP-001, CENT-002; table account_snapshots, class C3). The login is never stored in clear: only HMAC-SHA256(local_salt, login)[:12] plus salt_version (PRV-011/012). The salt itself never appears. MT5 enum fields are raw integers.

schema_version.description: Schema version (DATA-010). Breaking changes need a migration and an ADR line.

params.description: Present with value FIXTURE when fixture values of unapproved parameters are in effect (RISK-005, RISK-066 item 3, MI-045). Absent otherwise; the spec names no value for the approved case.

fixture_demo_mode.description: Fixture demo only: the entry authorization mode the user set for this run in fixture_demo_mode (RISK-066 item 4). Absent outside fixture demo.

mono_seq.description: Engine monotonic sequence number for ordering within a process (DATA-003). Optional because records not written by the engine (research, Guardian ingest) have none.

login_hash.description: First 12 hex characters of HMAC-SHA256(local_salt, login) (PRV-011).

salt_version.description: Version label of the local_salt used (PRV-012). A label, not the salt.

currency.description: account_info().currency; all risk maths use it (RISK-023).

account_class.description: Derived from MT5 data only (CENT-002). UNKNOWN leads to T15.

trade_mode.description: account_info().trade_mode, raw MT5 enum integer (demo/contest/real; RISK-066).

balance.description: Balance; shown, never used for sizing.

margin_level.description: Margin level in percent as MT5 reports it.

margin_so_mode.description: account_info().margin_so_mode, raw MT5 enum integer; decides whether margin_so_call/margin_so_so are percent or money.

margin_so_call.description: Margin-call level, in the unit selected by margin_so_mode.

margin_so_so.description: Stop-out level, in the unit selected by margin_so_mode (EXP-006).
